text:
mara: Quick brainstorm — we need a lean benchmark narrative for launch that ties latency -> cost into a short playbook. My initial idea: 3 visuals + routing matrix + two short CTAs. Goals: help eng teams pick the right deployment and capture inbound signal for Dedicated/Private.

sophie: Love that. For the main scatter (latency vs $/1k tokens) can we color by deployment mode (hosted / dedicated / private)? Use log scale for cost so tails don’t dominate.

tonY: +1 on coloring. Also add small insets showing 1k vs 8k context latency lines so ppl can see tail behavior. Keep annotations focused (e.g., 'low cost, best for scale', 'low latency, best for SLAs').

mara: Drafting proposed visuals list: 1) Scatter: latency vs $/1k tokens w/ deployment color and model slices. 2) Bar: effective tokens-per-dollar for common workloads (single-turn chat, multi-turn assistant, embedding indexing). 3) Routing decision tree: SLA threshold -> recommended deployment + CTA. Social card: simplified scatter w/ 1-line hook.

ryan: On inbound routing — require three form fields: tokens/day (numeric), security level (none/PPI/high), SLA priority (low/standard/critical). Routing rules: tokens/day > 500k -> tag as "dedicated_interest"; security=high -> tag "private_inquiry"; SLA=critical -> flag AE. Bench-bot, can you codify that into the routing doc?

bench-bot: Routing rules added to playbook draft. Example snippet: `if tokens_daily > 500000 then tag = "dedicated_interest"; if security_level == "high" then tag = "private_inquiry"; if sla_priority == "critical" then notify = "enterprise_ae"`

sophie: For webinar: 30 min + 10 Q. Proposed title: "Latency & Cost: Making LLM Inference Predictable" — panel with runtime eng + a customer. Keep gated landing to capture leads. CTA variants to A/B: "Start free" vs "Book a demo".

mara: Gated landing — agreed. Landing copy bullets: predictable per-token cost, same API across environments, SLA-backed capacity. Short CTAs: 1) Try hosted API, 2) Book consult for Dedicated, 3) Request private eval. Also want a 1-paragraph benchmark note (200-300 words) summarizing methodology and key takeaways for linked doc.

tonY: I'll mock the scatter and the social card by EOD and export a PNG + alt text. Which color palette do we want? Keep high-contrast for accessibility, and annotate median lines.

sophie: I’ll draft landing copy + webinar registration copy and post a first pass here by lunchtime. Also will write two 1-line social post variants: 1) engineer-focused (tech hooks), 2) product-focused (econ hooks).

ryan: I'll update the lead routing spreadsheet with the thresholds and map to SFDC fields. Question: Do we want auto-assignment to AE for any private_inquiry, or only when tokens + security both high?

mara: Auto-assign AE if security=high OR sla_priority=critical. Otherwise route to SDR with the tag. Keep escalation conservative but fast.

bench-bot: Noted and queued for automation. Tag mapping written to /playbooks/marketing/inbound-routing.md (internal link).

sophie: One more ask — can the benchmark note include a short methods section: models tested, sequence lengths, batch settings, quantization? That helps eng trust the numbers.

mara: Yes — methods: list model families, hardware for each mode, avg seq lengths (512, 2k), batching settings, and fallback rules. Keep it transparent.

mara: Assignments: tony = visual assets; sophie = landing + webinar copy + social lines; ryan = routing rules + SFDC mapping; mara = benchmark note intro + final narrative. We'll A/B test CTAs and landing gating. Ping if blocked. :rocket:

tonY: copying tasks into my calendar. will post first mock here when done.

sophie: posting copy draft in ~3h.

mara: perfect — thanks team. small follow-up: let's keep the public chart downloadable (CSV) so reporters / engs can reproduce. :thumbsup:
